messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — pen test confirmed for Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. We need a short playbook for temporary roles, KMS access, and a reproducible snapshot of audit logs. Who can own the evidence packaging?
Sarah K: I can own evidence packaging. Plan: create an evidence-escrow S3 bucket, presigned links + 30d retention. Need clear RBAC for assessors. Deadline to freeze role changes: Fri EOD.
Mohit R: Quick question — are we doing ephemeral assessor roles (sts:AssumeRole) or granting a dedicated assessor role? Ephemeral preferred (short TTL) to reduce blast radius. KMS: recommend a separate CMK with key policy that allows AssessorsDecrypt but denies key deletion.
Jada L: Ops notes — we can provision an "pt-evidence-escrow" bucket in us-west-2 and attach kms key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/pt-escrow-uuid. Will set bucket ACL to private + bucket policy to restrict to assessor-role ARN.
Mohit R: For audit logging, we'll need a consistent snapshot window. Suggest start = 08:30 PT, end = 13:30 PT (covers pre/post activity). Export CloudTrail + VPC flow logs + application request logs.
Alex W: Add acceptance criteria for retest: fixes must be deployed to staging tag pt-fix/*; remediation ticket updated with repro steps; logs attached or links to escrow; and a short security sign-off from oncall.
SecOps Bot: Reminder: enable continuous CloudTrail export prior to window. Command to export a time-bounded trail snapshot: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-10T08:30:00Z --end-time 2026-03-10T13:30:00Z --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=ec2.amazonaws.com > pt-cloudtrail.json
```
Also set S3 default encryption to KMS key pt-escrow-uuid.
Sarah K: We need a tamper-evidence checklist — hash each exported file and store checksums in a notarized ticket artifact. I'll include SHA256 sums and a small script to verify.
Mohit R: RBAC details: propose IAM role name "assessor/ephemeral-access" with maximum TTL 4h, permission boundary to read only the following prefixes: s3://pt-evidence-escrow/* and kms:Decrypt on pt-escrow-uuid. No console sign-in.
Oncall Pager: Who's on-call during the window? I can be the pager for the dry-run, but need a backup for the live test.
Jada L: I'll schedule a dry-run Fri 10:00 PT with the oncall and sec lead. I'll open an infra PR with the bucket + IAM role + KMS policy and post the link here.
Alex W: One more — retest logistics: vulnerabilities that require app-layer fixes must have a smoke-test script checked in (path: infra/pt/smoke-tests/) and CI job to run post-deploy. If smoke test fails, assessor notifies and we reschedule retest slot.
Sarah K: Draft checklist items I'm adding to PR: create escrow bucket, create CMK, create assessor role, export logs + checksum, presigned links + upload, confirm access matrix, freeze RBAC changes.
SecOps Bot: Audit note: tag all relevant resources with "pt:eng=eng-security" for easy query later.
Jada L: PR created: https://internal.redwood/example/pr/1428 — includes IAM policy diff and KMS key policy. Please review by Thu EOD.
Alex W: Thanks — big focus: clear TTLs, no permanent privileges, and reproducible audit snapshots. Ping here when PR reviewed. :thumbsup:
